task_metadata.research_topic: inverse problems with diffusion priors for scientific imaging
task_metadata.research_question: Design a novel algorithm for solving scientific inverse problems using pre-trained diffusion model priors.
notes: Baselines map to DPG, REDDiff, and LGD/MCGDiff from the task description and config.
Evaluation tests cover inverse scattering, Navier-Stokes reconstruction, and black-hole imaging.

tests.label: inv-scatter
tests.notes: Inverse scattering benchmark linked to physics-informed optical imaging.

tests.label: navier-stokes
tests.notes: Navier-Stokes reconstruction benchmark linked to NSFnets.

tests.label: blackhole
tests.notes: Black-hole imaging benchmark linked to M87*/Sgr A* shadow imaging.

baselines.name: dpg
baselines.notes: Exact paper for Diffusion Policy Gradient.

baselines.name: reddiff
baselines.notes: REDDiff is the method proposed in the variational diffusion inverse-problems paper.

baselines.name: lgd
baselines.notes: LGD aligns with Monte Carlo guided diffusion for Bayesian linear inverse problems.
